message.reasoning_content: Record description update. The key risk: pruning residual may exceed 1.0 on the box. Kernel computes only 0.25x0+0.5x1. Residual max: sum_j 0.25*max(dot - b_j,0). b_j = 0.75*sum|W_j|. Max possible dot is sum|W_j|, so max(W·x-b) = 0.25*sum|W_j| = b_j/3. Residual sum ≤ 6*0.25*(0.25*sum|W_j|) = 0.375*mean... worst case sum over j: 0.25*0.25*Σ|W_j| rows. Σ_j sum|W_j| ≤ 6*12*1 = 72, residual ≤ 0.0625*72*... wait: sum_j 0.25*(0.25*Σ|W_j|) = 0.25*0.25*ΣΣ|W| ≤ 0.0625*72 = 4.5. But achieving all max simultaneously requires aligning x with each row's sign pattern — rows differ (flips). Also with magnitudes 0.5/1.0 actual sums smaller. So worst case could exceed 1.0 potentially — that's a skeptic claim, not mine. Record risk: residual can reach up to 4.5 theoretically upper bound; need actual W analysis. Note base output itself bounded ±0.75.
